definitions.explanation: A small police facility in a rural or suburban area where an officer lives on-site with their family. Larger than a simple police box and typically staffed by a single officer who serves the local community.

examples.japanese: ⟦{村|むら}→村：02261_mura⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{駐在所|ちゅうざいしょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is one police substation in the village.

examples.japanese: {駐在所|ちゅうざいしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{巡査|じゅんさ}→巡査：04276_junsa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: I asked the officer at the police substation for directions.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{交番|こうばん}→交番：02879_kouban⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧{駐在所|ちゅうざいしょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}っている→守る：01986_mamoru⟧。
examples.english: In this area, it's a residential police substation rather than a police box that protects the residents' safety.

notes: Composed of ⟦{駐在|ちゅうざい}→駐在：18181_chuuzai⟧ (being stationed, residing) + ⟦{所|しょ}→〜所：09844_sho⟧ (place). Distinct from ⟦{交番|こうばん}→交番：02879_kouban⟧ (police box): a ⟦{交番|こうばん}→交番：02879_kouban⟧ is found in urban areas and staffed in shifts, while a {駐在所|ちゅうざいしょ} is in rural areas with a resident officer who lives there with their family. The officer is called ⟦{駐在|ちゅうざい}→駐在：18181_chuuzai⟧さん by locals and serves as a community figure. Common collocations: {駐在所|ちゅうざいしょ}⟦{勤務|きんむ}→勤務：04545_kinmu⟧ (service at a police substation), {駐在所|ちゅうざいしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{巡査|じゅんさ}→巡査：04276_junsa⟧ (the substation officer). A familiar concept in Japanese rural life and frequently appears in mystery and drama set in the countryside.
